entities.summary: Rr. Alberthiene Endah Kusumawardhani Hilaul-Sutoyo, better known as Alberthiene Endah, is an Indonesian biographer, novelist, and journalist. She is known for her in-depth biographies of Indonesian celebrities, such as Chrisye and Krisdayanti. She has been called "the most sought after biographer in [Indonesia]."
